name: dotclaude
description: Guardrails and working conventions for Claude Code: destructive-command and test-weakening guards, a verify-before-stop gate, compaction carry-over, a fast-mode/model lock, and an always-on output style that counters common agent failure patterns.

bash_guard.title: Bash guard
bash_guard.description: Ask before destructive git/filesystem/database commands, hook bypasses, and public side effects (publish, gh writes).

edit_guard.title: Edit guard
edit_guard.description: Ask before edits that remove test assertions, add skip markers, touch generated files, or edit Claude settings files.

stop_gate.title: Verify-before-stop gate
stop_gate.description: Send Claude back once when it stops after editing code without a later passing test/build/lint run.

compact_carryover.title: Compaction carry-over
compact_carryover.description: After compaction, restore your last few prompts verbatim plus git diff stat and the last check result.

subagent_guidance.title: Subagent guidance
subagent_guidance.description: Give subagents a short version of the dotclaude working conventions when they start (the main conversation gets them through the dotclaude output style).

model_lock.title: Fast-mode and model lock
model_lock.description: Block fast mode and block switches or subagent calls to models outside the allowed list.

allowed_models.title: Allowed models
allowed_models.description: Comma-separated model IDs or version prefixes the model lock permits.

commit_hygiene.title: Commit hygiene
commit_hygiene.description: On git commit, ask when the staged set contains .DS_Store, .env files, keys, build output, or a lockfile without its manifest.

codegraph_hint.title: CodeGraph hint
codegraph_hint.description: At session start, note in context when the repository has a .codegraph/ index.

cloakbrowser.title: CloakBrowser backend
cloakbrowser.description: Use CloakBrowser instead of agent-browser for antibot browsing. CloakBrowser uses Chromium patches to prevent bot detection.

cloakbrowser_humanize.title: CloakBrowser humanize
cloakbrowser_humanize.description: Enable human-like mouse movements and timing in CloakBrowser.

cloakbrowser_headless.title: CloakBrowser headless
cloakbrowser_headless.description: Run CloakBrowser in headless mode. Not recommended for hard antibot targets.

captcha_ocr_ddddocr.title: CAPTCHA OCR (ddddocr)
captcha_ocr_ddddocr.description: Enable offline CAPTCHA recognition via ddddocr-rs. Fallback only - prefer CloakBrowser to prevent CAPTCHAs.
